scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Peco Pecos?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
你打满50只大嘴鸟了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放弃

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
嗯，我觉得你还差得远呢...

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
请快点去把那50只美味...呃，讨厌的大嘴鸟解决掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
你确定要停止狩猎吗？
你目前的进度将会被清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
好吧，如果你改变主意了，随时欢迎回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Please hurry and kill 50 of those tasty err pesky Peco Pecos.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
请快点去把那50只美味...呃，讨厌的大嘴鸟解决掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Oh thank you so much!
I think that I can rest easily now.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
哦，太感谢你了！
我想我现在可以安心休息了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Peco Pecos are fascinating.
I am still doing my, uh, research...
But now it is of a different nature.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
大嘴鸟真是令人着迷。
我还在继续我那个...呃，研究...
不过现在研究的性质有点不同了。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
You see I've been uh, ''researching''
these animals by collecting their
Bill of Birds but lately they seem
to have become hostile towards me.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
你看，我一直都在...呃，"研究"这些动物，
通过收集它们的鸟喙，
但最近它们似乎对我充满敌意。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you do me a favor please?
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
能帮我个忙吗？

scripts.text: What kind of favor?
scripts.translation: 什么样的忙？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
I am so afraid that these Peco Pecos will hurt me for my, uh, researching activities.
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
我很害怕这些大嘴鸟会因为我那个...呃，研究活动而伤害我。

scripts.text:
[Gregor]
Can you help protect me by killing them?
I think I'll feel safer...
Please...
scripts.translation:
[格雷戈尔]
你能帮我杀了它们来保护我吗？
我觉得那样我会安全一点...
拜托了...
